caption: The exact trigonometric curve recovered from22December2025, its tangent, and w=z+i z-prime. Samples draw the curves; the nonvanishing and winding claims are certified separately by integer-polynomial Rouche reduction in independent_audit.py. The scalar x coordinate already requires an8-dimensional linear realization.

Explicit positive convolution models T_ij=A q^(i-j) for i>=j on weighted ell-one, with norm sum |f_i|R^i. Their exact norms are B(R)=A/(1-qR), and their80-fold composition norms are B(R)^80. Constants define these illustrative mathematical models; the plots do not reproduce or establish a measured machine-learning advantage.

A fully specified symmetric double-well model U(m)=m^4/4-m^2/2. For dM=-U-prime(M)dt+sqrt(2D)dW, the barrier is1/4 and the small-noise Kramers approximation for transition to the other well is sqrt(2)*pi*exp(1/(4D)). The right panel displays that asymptotic formula, not simulated or measured escape times.
